traditional: A soft contact. Action, conflict, and heat supports limitation, delay, and hard structure — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. Two malefics, eased by the soft angle, but still demanding.
modern: Drive meets limit. Disciplined endurance and the ability to pace yourself and keep going long after others quit. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Stamina and controlled, sustained effort. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize drive and limit into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what drive and limit have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Endurance and discipline; the friction is the constant start-stop of push against restraint.
shadow: The ease lets anger and recklessness and fear and rigidity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.body: An urgent job receives the permit, crew, or equipment needed for one safe stage to begin. Someone adjusts the sequence, secures a responsible supervisor, or narrows the task enough to move without violating the rule protecting the site. Mars keeps pressure on the immediate need, while Saturn defines the condition that makes action supportable. The sextile opens a practical route through the restriction, but someone still has to organize the work correctly. Progress begins because urgency accepts enough structure to stop wasting time at the same locked gate.
